description: Crosshair options (GitHub #16): the default is the old dynamic crosshair (9 px lines, 2 px thick, slop green, outlined); a static cyan dot+T without outline; a big magenta one at half alpha; Options -> Crosshair shows the live preview (at rest, spraying, on a bright wall) and the share code, and pasting a code there applies it

args.hud.xhair: l r t b · gap 3 len 9 th 2 · rgb(139, 255, 79) · 1 · outline

args: cl_crosshairstyle static; cl_crosshairsize 5; cl_crosshairgap -1; cl_crosshairthickness 1; cl_crosshairdot 1; cl_crosshair_t 1; cl_crosshair_drawoutline 0; cl_crosshaircolor #00ffff

args.hud.xhair: l r b dot · gap 2 len 5 th 1 · rgb(0, 255, 255) · 1

args: crosshair_code SLOP-CBIU-BIv/-T/8z; cl_crosshairsize 16; cl_crosshairthickness 4; cl_crosshairgap 4; cl_crosshaircolor #ff3aff; cl_crosshairalpha 128

args.hud.xhair: l r t b · gap 7 len 16 th 4 · rgb(255, 58, 255) · 0.502 · outline
